title: Phase 5.5.0.2 Human Decision Registry
registry_objective: Authoritative single-source-of-truth registry of all execution-blocking governance decisions.

decisions.relevant_evidence: Audit revealed that preserving original close[i] barriers (Alternative A) causes severe 1:5 risk-reward distortion on gapped opens. Alternative B re-anchors symmetric barriers to open[i+1]. Alternative C decouples directional signal from an independent trade exit policy.
available_options: Alternative A: Preserve original label barriers (Not Recommended due to R:R collapse)
Alternative B: Re-anchor symmetric economic barriers to open[i+1] fill price (Recommended for pure barrier testing)
Alternative C: Decouple directional signal from an independent economic exit policy (Recommended for systematic strategy)
decisions.recommendation: Alternative B for direct triple-barrier validation, or Alternative C for professional algorithmic execution.
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Alternative B preserves clean symmetric 1:1 volatility brackets. Alternative C requires validating a separate trade exit policy on Folds 3-4.

decisions.relevant_evidence: Frozen models were trained on labels where Class +1 represents upward excursions and Class -1 represents downward excursions. Directional short symmetry has not been independently proven.
available_options: Bidirectional execution with mandatory separate PnL reporting for Long, Short, and Combined
decisions.recommendation: Bidirectional execution with mandatory separate reporting. If short trades fail to demonstrate positive net expectancy, restrict deployment to long-only.
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Prevents masking short trade losses behind long trade profits during crypto bull regimes.

decisions.relevant_evidence: Canonical Parquet datasets lack empirical funding rates (FUNDING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE). 87.5% of trades do not cross a funding timestamp due to 60m maximum holding horizon.
available_options: Approve parametric sensitivity sweep (Neutral, Moderate Bull, Severe Bull, Moderate Bear) for Phase 5.5
Require external backfill of audited Binance/Bybit historical funding rates before Phase 5.5 execution
decisions.recommendation: Approve parametric sensitivity sweep for Phase 5.5 with explicit disclosure of UNVERIFIED_ASSUMPTION status.
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Enables economic backtesting without delay while maintaining strict transparency regarding data gaps.

decisions.relevant_evidence: Dimensional modeling confirms retail taker fees (10-12 bps) plus dynamic slippage/spread (6-8 bps) yield ~18.82 bps round-trip friction under typical conditions.
available_options: Base Case Tier: 15 bps round-trip (Requires VIP exchange fee tiers)
Conservative Tier: 20 bps round-trip (Standard retail taker fees + volatility buffer)
Severe Stress Tier: 30 bps round-trip (Extreme volatility and spread widening)
decisions.recommendation: Confirm 20 bps Conservative Tier as the mandatory pass/fail break-even gate (Gate 2).
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Guarantees strategy is not approved based on unrealistically low institutional fee assumptions.

decisions.relevant_evidence: 11 independent specialists share one account equity. Concurrent signals during market dislocations can cause capital exhaustion or correlated multi-position drawdowns.
available_options: Max 2 concurrent positions, max 2.0x gross leverage
Max 3 concurrent positions, max 3.0x gross leverage (Recommended)
Max 5 concurrent positions, max 5.0x gross leverage
decisions.recommendation: Approve maximum 3 concurrent positions and maximum 3.0x gross leverage with priority queue based on calibrated confidence Delta P.
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Enforces conservative capital protection while allowing multi-asset diversification.

decisions.relevant_evidence: XMRUSDT possesses only 83,863 candles (2026 only, 291 days) and only 1 minority-class sample at 20% coverage in Fold 5. All 55 frozen model binaries must be preserved unchanged.
available_options: Preserve XMR model artifacts, maintain specialist research eligibility, but EXCLUDE XMR from primary economic portfolio
Include XMR in primary portfolio despite data and class support deficit
decisions.recommendation: Preserve XMR model artifacts 100%, but exclude XMR from primary portfolio evaluation (report XMR in isolated appendix).
decisions.consequence_of_choice: Prevents single-year data deficit from distorting multi-year portfolio backtesting statistics.
